title: Marketing & Advertising
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas el vocabulario clave para discutir estrategias de marketing y publicidad en inglés.

parts.visual:
Términos clave de Marketing: 
- Target audience (Público objetivo). 
- Market research (Estudio de mercado). 
- Brand awareness (Reconocimiento de marca). 
- Campaign (Campaña).
parts.audio: Key marketing terms. Target audience is the specific group of consumers you want to reach. Market research is gathering information about consumers' needs. Brand awareness is how familiar people are with your brand. Campaign is a planned set of marketing activities.

parts.visual:
Verbos útiles: 
- Launch (Lanzar un producto/campaña). 
- Promote (Promocionar). 
- Advertise (Anunciar/Publicitar). 
Ej: We will launch a new advertising campaign to increase brand awareness.
parts.audio: Useful verbs. Launch, promote, and advertise. For example: We will launch a new advertising campaign to increase brand awareness.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta relacionada con marketing y publicidad.

questions.question: Who is our ____ audience for this new smartphone? (Público objetivo).
We need to do some market ____ before launching the product. (Estudio/Investigación).
The new social media ____ starts next Monday. (Campaña).
Our main goal is to increase brand ____. (Reconocimiento de marca).
questions.explanation: Brand awareness = reconocimiento de marca (qué tan conocida es).

questions.question: We will ____ the new software in September. (Lanzar).
questions.explanation: Launch = lanzar (un producto, servicio o campaña).

questions.question: How are we going to ____ this event? (Promocionar).
We need to ____ our products on television and online. (Anunciar/Publicitar - verbo).
questions.explanation: Advertise es el verbo (anunciar). Advertisement es el sustantivo (anuncio).

questions.question: I saw a great ____ for that car on YouTube. (Anuncio - sustantivo corto).
Apple has a very strong ____ image. (Imagen de marca).
What is our marketing ____ for next year? (Estrategia).
They hired an advertising ____ to create the video. (Agencia).
We are targeting a specific market ____. (Segmento).
Their new logo is very ____. People will remember it. (Pegadizo/Fácil de recordar).
questions.explanation: Catchy = pegadizo (ideal para logos, slogans o canciones).

questions.question: Nike's ____ is 'Just Do It'. (Eslogan).
We don't have the ____ for a TV commercial. (Presupuesto).
They are doing a ____ analysis to see what other companies are doing. (Análisis de la competencia).
questions.explanation: Competitor analysis = análisis de la competencia.

questions.question: The product has a unique selling ____ (USP). (Propuesta).
questions.explanation: Unique Selling Proposition (USP) = Propuesta Única de Venta.

questions.question: We will distribute free ____ in the supermarket. (Muestras).
The ____ rate on our website has increased. (Tasa de conversión).
questions.explanation: Conversion rate = tasa de conversión (de visitantes a clientes).

questions.question: Social media is an important marketing ____. (Canal).
